Even sleep isn't a refuge; I'm plagued by these terribly vivid and distressing nightmares nearly every night. My mind feels so cloudy, like I'm walking through a fog. Simple tasks that used to be second nature feel overwhelming, and I've pretty much stopped doing much of anything around the house. Sometimes, I even find myself thinking, 'I wish I could just disappear,' or 'What's the point of going on?' I'd never act on it, but the thoughts are there. It's just so unlike me. I did have a period a while back, maybe a few weeks, where I felt much more energetic and barely needed sleep, buzzing with ideas, but it wasn't anything serious enough to cause any trouble or make others worried. It certainly wasn't like a full-blown episode where I lost touch or anything; it just felt like a good stretch, if that makes sense. I don't have a history of anything like that before or since."

Suddenly I’ll have all this energy, feel incredibly sharp, need hardly any sleep, and just get so much done. I remember one time, I reorganized my entire house in a weekend, felt on top of the world, like I could do anything. My family has even commented on these 'up' spells over the years. It only lasts a few days, maybe a week, and then I crash back down like this. This extreme low is what’s stopping me from living my life."

I go to bed, I sleep, but I wake up feeling like I haven't slept a wink, still drained. Everything feels so slow, like my body is moving through molasses, even just getting up to walk to the cockpit. I feel so worthless, like I'm failing at everything – my job, my marriage, just existing. It's gotten so bad that I'm on extended leave; I just can't function at work.

What’s really confusing though, is that sometimes, for a few days here and there, I’ll feel completely different. I'll get this surge of energy, practically buzzing, and I can go with very little sleep, feeling totally refreshed. My thoughts race, ideas come to me quickly, and I get so much done, almost too much. My wife even mentioned how I was talking a mile a minute and seemed unusually upbeat a few times last year. It’s never lasted more than a few days, maybe a week, and then I crash right back into this deep hole I’m in now. It's like I have these brief periods where I'm on top of the world, but it eventually fades.

I sleep a lot, sometimes 10-12 hours and I still wake up feeling drained. Driving the cab used to be okay, I mean, you meet people, right? But lately, I just… I don’t want to talk to anyone. And then there are these other times, usually for a few days, where I just can’t sit still. My foot just taps and taps, or I’ll pick at my cuticles until they’re raw without even realizing it. I used to enjoy chatting with my regulars, but now I avoid eye contact, and even talking to my kids feels like too much effort sometimes. I feel so worthless as a father and a provider, especially after the divorce. I just can't shake this feeling that I'm a complete failure.

The worst part is the constant exhaustion. I can sleep for 10-12 hours and still wake up feeling like I haven't rested at all. Sometimes, I find myself pacing around the apartment for no reason, or playing with my hands, just this restless energy I can't get rid of, even though I'm so drained.
